title: Testing and Verification Report
subtitle: Based on ISO/IEC 17025 and IEC 60068
test_name: Load Regulation and Stability Verification for DUT
purpose_obj: To verify the functional and electrical stability of the DUT under varying load conditions.
purpose_limits: The test covers the main power stage and control logic; thermal chambers are excluded from this scope.
purpose_focus: The focus is on validating output ripple voltage and thermal drifting under continuous operation.
definitions: \item \textbf{DUT:} Device Under Test -- The hardware unit being tested. \item \textbf{EUT:} Equipment Under Test -- Used interchangeably with DUT in some international standards. \item \textbf{RBF:} Remove-Before-Flight safety pin.
equip_data: 1 & Digital Multimeter & 34465A & Keysight & 2024-02-15 & XYZ123 & High precision \\ \hline 2 & DC Electronic Load & N3300A & Agilent & 2023-11-20 & ABC789 & 600W Max
criteria: Maximum peak-to-peak ripple shall not exceed 50mV
proc_table: 1 & Startup & 12V In / 0A Out & 12.01V & Pass \\ \hline 2 & Full Load & 12V In / 5A Out & 11.95V & Pass \\ \hline 3 & Transient & 0A to 5A Step & 11.85V (Recovery 20ms) & Pass
results_raw: Oscilloscope screenshots and raw data logs are provided in Annex A.
results_analysis: The DUT showed excellent stability with less than 0.5 percent voltage drop under full load conditions. No thermal drifting was observed.
conclusion_obs: The DUT met all operational requirements and safety constraints specified in the test plan.
